answer: Walnut-Based Identity Confirmation** This mechanism requires each agent to provide three unique identifiers: a walnut accessory, a velvet texture sample, and a piece of timber from a unique tree. To enter the economy, users must submit these items for verification. Each item must come from an independent source, confirmed through a decentralized network of validators. Attackers attempting to create multiple identities will incur high costs; sourcing and verifying dozens of distinct natural materials is both time-consuming and expensive.
